# API reference

Every name that `import pyropdf` exports, grouped by topic. Signatures and
descriptions come from the package itself. Each topic's page gives every
method and property of its classes with its full description.

## [Documents](documents.md)

- [`__version__`](documents.md#__version__): The version string of the installed pyropdf package.
- [`Document`](documents.md#document): A PDF document.
- [`open`](documents.md#open): Open a PDF from a file path or from the bytes of a document.
- [`Probe`](documents.md#probe): What `probe` reads without loading the whole document.
- [`probe`](documents.md#probe_1): Read the page count, version, encryption, and metadata without loading the whole document.

## [Metadata](metadata.md)

- [`Duplex`](metadata.md#duplex): How a print dialog prints both sides by default (`/Duplex`).
- [`MarkInfo`](metadata.md#markinfo): The catalog's `/MarkInfo` flags of a tagged document (ISO 32000-2 Table 356).
- [`Metadata`](metadata.md#metadata_1): The document's Info dictionary as a live mapping, as `doc.metadata` returns it.
- [`METADATA_KEYS`](metadata.md#metadata_keys): The Info dictionary entries that `Document.metadata` holds, by their names in pyropdf, and their PDF keys.
- [`PageBoundary`](metadata.md#pageboundary): A page box that viewers and printers show or clip to (`/ViewArea` and its kin).
- [`PageLayout`](metadata.md#pagelayout): How a viewer lays pages out (`/PageLayout`, ISO 32000-2 Table 29).
- [`PageMode`](metadata.md#pagemode): How a viewer opens the document (`/PageMode`, ISO 32000-2 Table 29).
- [`parse_pdf_date`](metadata.md#parse_pdf_date): Return the moment of a PDF date string, or `None` when it is not one.
- [`pdf_date`](metadata.md#pdf_date): Return `moment` as a PDF date string, such as `"D:20240101120000Z"`; a naive moment is UTC.
- [`PrintScaling`](metadata.md#printscaling): Whether a print dialog scales pages by default (`/PrintScaling`).
- [`ReadingDirection`](metadata.md#readingdirection): The reading order of the text, which lays out side-by-side pages (`/Direction`).
- [`ViewerPreferences`](metadata.md#viewerpreferences): The catalog's `/ViewerPreferences` (ISO 32000-2 Table 147).

## [Page labels](page-labels.md)

- [`PageLabelRange`](page-labels.md#pagelabelrange): The labels of the pages from `start` up to the next range.
- [`PageLabelStyle`](page-labels.md#pagelabelstyle): How a page-label range numbers its pages (`/S`, ISO 32000-2 table 161).

## [Images](images.md)

- [`ImageRewriteReport`](images.md#imagerewritereport): What `Document.rewrite_images` did.
- [`PageImage`](images.md#pageimage): One image that a page paints: its content item and its place among the page's images.
- [`StoredImage`](images.md#storedimage): An image's data as the document stores it, for an image filter that a file format holds.

## [Recoloring](recoloring.md)

- [`RecolorReport`](recoloring.md#recolorreport): What `Page.recolor` or `Document.recolor` converted, and what it could not.
- [`RecolorTarget`](recoloring.md#recolortarget): A target color space of `Page.recolor` and `Document.recolor`.
- [`Unconverted`](recoloring.md#unconverted): A color that `Page.recolor` left as it was.

## [Layers](layers.md)

- [`Layer`](layers.md#layer): An optional content group (`/Type /OCG`) and its state in the default configuration.
- [`LayerConfig`](layers.md#layerconfig): An optional content configuration: the default `/D` at index 0, then each of `/Configs`.
- [`LayerMembership`](layers.md#layermembership): An optional content membership dictionary (`/OCMD`) as a value.
- [`Layers`](layers.md#layers_1): The optional content groups of a document, in `/OCGs` order; empty without optional content.
- [`VisibilityPolicy`](layers.md#visibilitypolicy): How a membership's groups decide its visibility (`/P`, ISO 32000-2 Table 97).

## [Sanitizing](sanitizing.md)

- [`SanitizeReport`](sanitizing.md#sanitizereport): What `Document.sanitize` removed, and what the result invalidates.

## [Fonts](fonts.md)

- [`FallbackFont`](fonts.md#fallbackfont): The faces that render the CJK fonts of one language that a document does not embed.
- [`FallbackFonts`](fonts.md#fallbackfonts): The fonts that render the CJK fonts that a document does not embed, from `Document.fallback_fonts`.
- [`Font`](fonts.md#font): A font face that draws and measures text.
- [`FontInfo`](fonts.md#fontinfo): One font dictionary that a page's resources name, from `Page.fonts`.
- [`FontProgram`](fonts.md#fontprogram): An embedded font program, from `Document.font_program`.
- [`StandardFontName`](fonts.md#standardfontname): The PostScript names of the Standard 14 fonts (ISO 32000-2 section 9.6.2.2).
- [`SubsetFont`](fonts.md#subsetfont): One font program that `Document.subset_fonts` subset.

## [Pages](pages.md)

- [`BoxStyle`](pages.md#boxstyle): Stored DeviceRGB guideline colour, width, solid/dashed style and dash pattern.
- [`FixedPrint`](pages.md#fixedprint): Watermark matrix and translations as fractions of the target media width and height.
- [`NavigationStep`](pages.md#navigationstep): One sub-page navigation step of a page's presentation sequence (`NavNode`, ISO 32000-2 Table 166).
- [`Page`](pages.md#page): A page of a document, named by its page object.
- [`Pages`](pages.md#pages_1): The pages of a document, in order.
- [`PrinterMark`](pages.md#printermark): A printable, read-only printer's mark with a supplied Form XObject and optional mark name.
- [`SeparationPlate`](pages.md#separationplate): The colorant of one pre-separated page and its optional Separation or DeviceN space.
- [`Transition`](pages.md#transition_1): How a viewer transitions to a page during a presentation (`/Trans`, ISO 32000-2 Table 165).
- [`TransitionAction`](pages.md#transitionaction): An action that updates the display using a `Transition` (`/S /Trans`, ISO 32000-2 Table 219).
- [`TransitionDimension`](pages.md#transitiondimension): Axis along which a `Split` or `Blinds` transition runs (`/Dm`, ISO 32000-2 Table 165).
- [`TransitionMotion`](pages.md#transitionmotion): Direction of motion for `Split`, `Box`, or `Fly` transitions (`/M`, ISO 32000-2 Table 165).
- [`TransitionStyle`](pages.md#transitionstyle): Visual style of a page transition (`/S`, ISO 32000-2 Table 165).
- [`Watermark`](pages.md#watermark): A printable watermark with a supplied Form and optional fixed placement on the target media.

## [Drawing](drawing.md)

- [`Canvas`](drawing.md#canvas): Drawing on one page in paint order, written as one content stream.
- [`ListNumbering`](drawing.md#listnumbering): How a list numbers its items (ISO 32000-1 section 14.8.5.5), by its PDF name.
- [`PathBuilder`](drawing.md#pathbuilder): Geometry for `Canvas.path` and `Canvas.clip`, built from segments.
- [`PathInput`](drawing.md#pathinput): Geometry accepted by `Canvas.path` and `Canvas.clip`: a `PathBuilder`, a `Path`, or segments.
- [`TableHeaderScope`](drawing.md#tableheaderscope): What a table header cell heads (ISO 32000-1 section 14.8.5.7), by its PDF name.
- [`TagRole`](drawing.md#tagrole): A structure type (ISO 32000-1 section 14.8.4), by its PDF name.
- [`TextFit`](drawing.md#textfit): How text fits a `Canvas.textbox`: the height left below its last line.

## [Text and content](text-and-content.md)

- [`BlendMode`](text-and-content.md#blendmode): A blend mode of ISO 32000-2 §11.3.5.
- [`Block`](text-and-content.md#block): A block of lines of a `Layout`; `text` joins the lines with newlines.
- [`Char`](text-and-content.md#char): One glyph of a `Span`, from `Page.layout` with `chars=True`.
- [`Chars`](text-and-content.md#chars): The chars of a page as columns, from `Page.chars` and `Layout.chars`.
- [`Chunk`](text-and-content.md#chunk): Consecutive elements within one section, joined as Markdown in `text`.
- [`Clip`](text-and-content.md#clip): A clipping path in display space.
- [`ClosePath`](text-and-content.md#closepath): Close the current subpath with a line to its start.
- [`Color`](text-and-content.md#color): A solid paint in sRGB with optional stored PDF color space and components.
- [`ColorStop`](text-and-content.md#colorstop): A place on a gradient's line, and the color and alpha there.
- [`Content`](text-and-content.md#content): The items that a page paints, in paint order.
- [`ContentItem`](text-and-content.md#contentitem): One painted item yielded by `Page.content`: a `TextRun`, `Path`, or `Image`.
- [`CurveTo`](text-and-content.md#curveto): Draw a cubic Bézier curve to `to` with two control points.
- [`Element`](text-and-content.md#element): One piece of a page's structure, with where it is.
- [`ElementKind`](text-and-content.md#elementkind): The kind of a structured page `Element`.
- [`ExportedImage`](text-and-content.md#exportedimage): One image prepared for Markdown, JSON, or chunk export.
- [`FillRule`](text-and-content.md#fillrule): The rule that decides which areas a path fills or clips.
- [`FontRef`](text-and-content.md#fontref): The font that a text run uses, from its PDF font dictionary and font program.
- [`Glyph`](text-and-content.md#glyph): One glyph of a text run.
- [`Gradient`](text-and-content.md#gradient): A linear or radial gradient paint for a `Canvas`.
- [`GradientExtend`](text-and-content.md#gradientextend): What a gradient paints beyond the two ends of its line.
- [`GraphicsContext`](text-and-content.md#graphicscontext): The clips, transparency groups, and marked content around an item.
- [`Image`](text-and-content.md#image): An image painted on the page.
- [`ImageMask`](text-and-content.md#imagemask): The kind of mask that an image dictionary names.
- [`Layout`](text-and-content.md#layout): The text of a page as blocks, lines, spans, and, on request, characters.
- [`Line`](text-and-content.md#line): A line of a `Block`.
- [`LinearGradient`](text-and-content.md#lineargradient): A paint for a `Canvas` that changes color along a straight line.
- [`LineCap`](text-and-content.md#linecap): The shape at the open ends of a stroke.
- [`LineJoin`](text-and-content.md#linejoin): The shape at the corners of a stroke.
- [`LineTo`](text-and-content.md#lineto): Draw a line to `to`.
- [`MarkedContent`](text-and-content.md#markedcontent): A marked-content sequence (`BMC` or `BDC`).
- [`MoveTo`](text-and-content.md#moveto): Start a new subpath at `to`.
- [`Paint`](text-and-content.md#paint): A solid color, pattern, shading, or gradient paint; a canvas also repaints axial/radial `ShadingPattern` and `TilingPattern` values.
- [`Path`](text-and-content.md#path): A path that is filled, stroked, or both.
- [`PathCluster`](text-and-content.md#pathcluster): A display-space cluster of nearby vector paths.
- [`Paths`](text-and-content.md#paths_1): The paths of a page as columns, from `Page.paths`.
- [`PatternPaint`](text-and-content.md#patternpaint): Paint with an indirect tiling or shading pattern in the canvas document.
- [`RadialGradient`](text-and-content.md#radialgradient): A paint for a `Canvas` that changes color between two circles.
- [`Segment`](text-and-content.md#segment): One path construction segment of a `Path` or `PathBuilder`.
- [`ShadingPattern`](text-and-content.md#shadingpattern): A paint that a shading fills, from a shading pattern or `sh`.
- [`ShadingType`](text-and-content.md#shadingtype): A shading type of ISO 32000-2 §8.7.4.5.
- [`SoftMask`](text-and-content.md#softmask): A soft mask: the transparency group that masks what it encloses.
- [`SoftMaskType`](text-and-content.md#softmasktype): What a soft mask reads from its group: alpha or luminosity.
- [`Span`](text-and-content.md#span): A run of text in one font, size, paint, and render mode within a `Line`.
- [`Stroke`](text-and-content.md#stroke): How a path or text run is stroked, in display space.
- [`Table`](text-and-content.md#table): A table that `Page.tables` detected, in display space.
- [`TableDiagnostics`](text-and-content.md#tablediagnostics): The geometric evidence for one detected table.
- [`TextRenderMode`](text-and-content.md#textrendermode): How a text run paints its glyphs.
- [`TextRun`](text-and-content.md#textrun): The glyphs that one text-showing operator paints.
- [`TilingPattern`](text-and-content.md#tilingpattern): A paint that repeats a pattern cell.
- [`TransparencyGroup`](text-and-content.md#transparencygroup): A transparency group and what it applies to everything inside it.
- [`Unmapped`](text-and-content.md#unmapped): What text extraction makes of a glyph without Unicode: `"skip"` leaves it out with a `PyropdfWarning`, `"replacement"` gives U+FFFD, and `"glyph_id"` gives the character whose code point is the glyph ID. `"type3_char_code"` treats an unmapped Type 3 font's original character code as a Unicode code point. This heuristic can produce unrelated text for custom encodings. Other unmapped glyphs give U+FFFD. Font Unicode mappings and recognized glyph names take precedence.
- [`Word`](text-and-content.md#word): One word of `Page.words`, in reading order.
- [`WritingMode`](text-and-content.md#writingmode): The writing mode of a text run's font (ISO 32000-2 §9.2.4).

## [OCR](ocr.md)

- [`OcrEngine`](ocr.md#ocrengine): Reusable, pure-Rust PP-OCR engine.
- [`OcrMode`](ocr.md#ocrmode): Which parts of a page OCR recognizes or inserts: `"full"` for the whole page or `clip`, `"skip_existing"` to skip when extractable text is already present, or `"hybrid"` to recognize only uncovered raster-image regions and drop words that duplicate existing native text.
- [`OcrRotation`](ocr.md#ocrrotation): A clockwise correction of sideways OCR input, in degrees.
- [`OcrWord`](ocr.md#ocrword): One recognized word: its text, its box, and the engine's confidence from 0 to 1.

## [Rendering](rendering.md)

- [`Colorspace`](rendering.md#colorspace): The color space of a `Pixmap`'s samples.
- [`Pixmap`](rendering.md#pixmap): A rendered page: immutable pixels, row by row from the top, RGB or gray, each with or without straight alpha, 8 bits per channel.

## [Annotations](annotations.md)

- [`Annotation`](annotations.md#annotation): A handle on one annotation of a page, as `page.annotations` lists it.
- [`AnnotationFile`](annotations.md#annotationfile): The file that a file attachment annotation embeds, as `Annotation.file` returns it.
- [`AnnotationFlags`](annotations.md#annotationflags): Annotation `/F` bit flags (ISO 32000-2 Table 167).
- [`Annotations`](annotations.md#annotations_1): The annotations of a page other than links and form widgets, as `page.annotations` returns them.
- [`AnnotationSpecification`](annotations.md#annotationspecification): The specifications that `page.annotations.add` takes.
- [`AnnotationType`](annotations.md#annotationtype): Annotation types by `/Subtype` (ISO 32000-2 §12.5.6); `UNKNOWN` (-1) marks an unrecognized subtype.
- [`AttachmentIcon`](annotations.md#attachmenticon): The icon of a file attachment, `/Name` (ISO 32000-2 §12.5.6.15).
- [`Border`](annotations.md#border_1): The border of an annotation: its line width, style, and dash pattern.
- [`BorderStyle`](annotations.md#borderstyle): The style of an annotation's border, `/BS /S` (ISO 32000-2 Table 168).
- [`Caret`](annotations.md#caret): A caret that marks where text goes, as `page.annotations.add` takes it.
- [`Circle`](annotations.md#circle): An ellipse inscribed in a rectangle, as `page.annotations.add` takes it.
- [`FileAttachment`](annotations.md#fileattachment): A file embedded in the page behind an icon, as `page.annotations.add` takes it.
- [`FreeText`](annotations.md#freetext): Text written on the page in a box, as `page.annotations.add` takes it.
- [`Highlight`](annotations.md#highlight): A highlight over text, as `page.annotations.add` takes it.
- [`Ink`](annotations.md#ink): Freehand strokes, each through one or more display points, as `page.annotations.add` takes it.
- [`LineAnnotation`](annotations.md#lineannotation): A straight line between two display points, as `page.annotations.add` takes it.
- [`LineDetails`](annotations.md#linedetails): Leader lengths in default user space and the caption placement of a line.
- [`LineEnding`](annotations.md#lineending): The shape at an end of a line or polyline, `/LE` (ISO 32000-2 Table 179).
- [`MarkupRects`](annotations.md#markuprects): Rectangles or quads that text markup covers: one, or a sequence of them.
- [`MediaAsset`](annotations.md#mediaasset): An embedded media file shared by its file specification and media instances.
- [`MediaKind`](annotations.md#mediakind): Base-standard RichMedia configuration and instance subtypes.
- [`ModelFormat`](annotations.md#modelformat): Embedded base-standard 3D stream formats.
- [`ModelMeasurement`](annotations.md#modelmeasurement): Geometry of one 3D measurement in model coordinates.
- [`ModelMeasurementType`](annotations.md#modelmeasurementtype): Kinds of stored 3D measurements and markups (ISO 32000-2, Tables 326–331).
- [`ModelView`](annotations.md#modelview): A named 3D view, its camera-to-world matrix, scene settings and measurements.
- [`Note`](annotations.md#note): A note shown as an icon, as `page.annotations.add` takes it.
- [`NoteIcon`](annotations.md#noteicon): The icon of a note, `/Name` (ISO 32000-2 §12.5.6.4).
- [`Polygon`](annotations.md#polygon): A closed polygon through two or more display points, as `page.annotations.add` takes it.
- [`PolyLine`](annotations.md#polyline): An open line through two or more display points, as `page.annotations.add` takes it.
- [`PopupInfo`](annotations.md#popupinfo): Effective markup shown in a pop-up window and its initial display state.
- [`ProjectionAnnotation`](annotations.md#projectionannotation): A projection annotation that links back to a 3D measurement.
- [`RedactionMark`](annotations.md#redactionmark): Mark a rectangle or quadrilaterals for later redaction.
- [`RichMedia`](annotations.md#richmedia): A RichMedia annotation with a named asset, configuration, instance and optional 3D views.
- [`RichMediaModel`](annotations.md#richmediamodel): A STEP or glTF model resolved from a PDF 2.0 RichMedia instance.
- [`Screen`](annotations.md#screen): A Screen annotation with an optional media clip and its rendition action.
- [`SlideShow`](annotations.md#slideshow): An existing embedded slideshow and the UTF-8 resource names in its virtual file system.
- [`Sound`](annotations.md#sound_1): The sound of a sound annotation, `/Sound`, as `Annotation.sound` reads it.
- [`SoundEncoding`](annotations.md#soundencoding): How a sound's samples encode amplitudes, `/E` (ISO 32000-2 Table 208).
- [`Square`](annotations.md#square): A rectangle, as `page.annotations.add` takes it.
- [`Squiggly`](annotations.md#squiggly): A wavy line under text, as `page.annotations.add` takes it.
- [`Stamp`](annotations.md#stamp): A rubber stamp, as `page.annotations.add` takes it.
- [`StampIcon`](annotations.md#stampicon): Standard rubber-stamp icon names, `/Name` (ISO 32000-2 §12.5.6.12).
- [`StrikeOut`](annotations.md#strikeout): A line through text, as `page.annotations.add` takes it.
- [`ThreeD`](annotations.md#threed): A 3D annotation whose stream holds an opaque U3D or PRC asset.
- [`Underline`](annotations.md#underline): A line under text, as `page.annotations.add` takes it.

## [Links and destinations](links-and-destinations.md)

- [`Destination`](links-and-destinations.md#destination): A place in this document: a zero-based page, a point, and a zoom.
- [`Destinations`](links-and-destinations.md#destinations): The named destinations of a document, as `doc.destinations` returns them.
- [`FragmentParameter`](links-and-destinations.md#fragmentparameter): One parameter of a PDF fragment, resolved in its original order.
- [`Launch`](links-and-destinations.md#launch): Open a file with the application the viewer associates with it.
- [`Link`](links-and-destinations.md#link): A handle on one link annotation of a page, as `page.links` lists it.
- [`Links`](links-and-destinations.md#links): The link annotations of a page, in `/Annots` order, as `page.links` returns them.
- [`NamedAction`](links-and-destinations.md#namedaction): A viewer action by name (ISO 32000-2 Table 213).
- [`NamedResources`](links-and-destinations.md#namedresources): Live byte-string keys and PDF objects in one catalog resource name tree.
- [`PdfFragment`](links-and-destinations.md#pdffragment): Ordered content selectors and viewer parameters from a PDF URI's fragment.
- [`RemoteDestination`](links-and-destinations.md#remotedestination): A place in another PDF file: a zero-based page or a named destination.
- [`StructureDestination`](links-and-destinations.md#structuredestination): A PDF 2.0 structure destination and its page-based fallback.
- [`Target`](links-and-destinations.md#target_1): Where a link or trigger leads: a destination, a file to open, a viewer, transition, thread, script, hide, layer-state, or form action, or a URI string.
- [`UriAction`](links-and-destinations.md#uriaction): A URI reference and the optional image-map click flag of a PDF URI action.
- [`WindowsLaunch`](links-and-destinations.md#windowslaunch): Windows-specific fields in a launch action, retained as data (PDF 1.1 through 1.7).

## [Actions and triggers](actions-and-triggers.md)

- [`ActionTriggers`](actions-and-triggers.md#actiontriggers): Additional actions of a widget or screen annotation by `AnnotationTrigger` (Table 197).
- [`AnnotationTrigger`](actions-and-triggers.md#annotationtrigger): Widget and screen-annotation trigger events (ISO 32000-2 Table 197).
- [`DocumentScripts`](actions-and-triggers.md#documentscripts): The document's `/Names /JavaScript` name tree as a live mutable mapping (ISO 32000-2 §12.6.4.17).
- [`DocumentTrigger`](actions-and-triggers.md#documenttrigger): Catalog additional-action events (`Catalog["AA"]`, ISO 32000-2 Table 200).
- [`DocumentTriggers`](actions-and-triggers.md#documenttriggers): Catalog additional-action scripts by `DocumentTrigger` (`Catalog["AA"]`, Table 200).
- [`EmbeddedDestination`](actions-and-triggers.md#embeddeddestination): An embedded go-to action into an embedded or parent PDF file (`/S /GoToE`, ISO 32000-2 Table 204).
- [`EmbeddedTarget`](actions-and-triggers.md#embeddedtarget): One hop in an embedded go-to target path (`/T`, ISO 32000-2 Table 205).
- [`GoTo3DView`](actions-and-triggers.md#goto3dview): Select a target's 3D view by index, internal name, PDF selector name, or view dictionary.
- [`HideAction`](actions-and-triggers.md#hideaction): An action that hides or shows annotations and form fields (`/S /Hide`, ISO 32000-2 Table 214).
- [`ImportDataAction`](actions-and-triggers.md#importdataaction): An action that imports FDF field values from a file (`/S /ImportData`, ISO 32000-2 Table 243).
- [`JavaScriptAction`](actions-and-triggers.md#javascriptaction): An action that runs an ECMAScript script (`/S /JavaScript`, ISO 32000-2 Table 221).
- [`LayerStateChange`](actions-and-triggers.md#layerstatechange): One transition group inside a `SetLayerStateAction` `/State` array (ISO 32000-2 Table 217).
- [`LayerStateTransition`](actions-and-triggers.md#layerstatetransition): How a `LayerStateChange` updates optional content groups (ISO 32000-2 Table 217).
- [`MovieAction`](actions-and-triggers.md#movieaction): An existing Movie action interpreted on its destination page (ISO 32000-1 §12.6.4.9).
- [`PageTrigger`](actions-and-triggers.md#pagetrigger): Page additional-action events (`Page["AA"]`, ISO 32000-2 Table 198).
- [`PageTriggers`](actions-and-triggers.md#pagetriggers): Page additional actions by `PageTrigger` (`Page["AA"]`, ISO 32000-2 Table 198).
- [`RenditionAction`](actions-and-triggers.md#renditionaction): A Screen target, optional rendition, operation and inert script.
- [`RenditionOperation`](actions-and-triggers.md#renditionoperation): The operation requested of a viewer by a rendition action.
- [`ResetFormAction`](actions-and-triggers.md#resetformaction): An action that resets form fields to their default values (`/S /ResetForm`, ISO 32000-2 Table 241).
- [`RichMediaExecute`](actions-and-triggers.md#richmediaexecute): An inert command and optional arguments for an instance of a RichMedia annotation.
- [`SetLayerStateAction`](actions-and-triggers.md#setlayerstateaction): An action that changes optional-content group states (`/S /SetOCGState`, ISO 32000-2 Table 217).
- [`SubmitFormAction`](actions-and-triggers.md#submitformaction): An action that submits form field values to a URL (`/S /SubmitForm`, ISO 32000-2 Table 239).
- [`SubmitFormFlags`](actions-and-triggers.md#submitformflags): Bit flags of a `SubmitFormAction` (`/Flags`, ISO 32000-2 Table 240).

## [Forms and widgets](forms-and-widgets.md)

- [`CheckBox`](forms-and-widgets.md#checkbox): A check box, as `page.widgets.add` takes it.
- [`ComboBox`](forms-and-widgets.md#combobox): A drop-down choice field, as `page.widgets.add` takes it.
- [`FdfData`](forms-and-widgets.md#fdfdata): Form field values and target-document metadata read by `parse_fdf` or `parse_xfdf`.
- [`Field`](forms-and-widgets.md#field): A handle on one terminal form field, as `doc.form[name]` returns it.
- [`FieldChoice`](forms-and-widgets.md#fieldchoice): One option of a choice field's `/Opt`.
- [`FieldFlags`](forms-and-widgets.md#fieldflags): The field flags of `/Ff` (ISO 32000-2 Tables 227, 229, 231, and 233).
- [`FieldSpecification`](forms-and-widgets.md#fieldspecification): The specifications that `page.widgets.add` takes.
- [`FieldType`](forms-and-widgets.md#fieldtype): The kind of a form field, from its `/FT` and the flags that refine it.
- [`Form`](forms-and-widgets.md#form): The terminal fields of a document's interactive form, as `doc.form` returns them.
- [`IconFit`](forms-and-widgets.md#iconfit): Pushbutton icon scaling and alignment, shared by its three display modes.
- [`ListBox`](forms-and-widgets.md#listbox): A list of choices, as `page.widgets.add` takes it.
- [`parse_fdf`](forms-and-widgets.md#parse_fdf): Parse an FDF file or byte buffer into `FdfData` (ISO 32000-2 section 12.7.8).
- [`parse_xfdf`](forms-and-widgets.md#parse_xfdf): Parse an XFDF file, XML string, or byte buffer into `FdfData` (ISO 19444-1).
- [`PushButton`](forms-and-widgets.md#pushbutton): A pushbutton, which holds no value, as `page.widgets.add` takes it.
- [`RadioButton`](forms-and-widgets.md#radiobutton): One button of a radio group, as `page.widgets.add` takes it.
- [`Scripts`](forms-and-widgets.md#scripts_1): The JavaScript of a field or widget by trigger, as `field.scripts` and `widget.scripts` return them.
- [`ScriptTrigger`](forms-and-widgets.md#scripttrigger): When a viewer runs a form script: the field triggers of `field.scripts`, the widget ones of `widget.scripts`.
- [`SignatureField`](forms-and-widgets.md#signaturefield): An unsigned signature field, which a signing tool such as pyHanko fills, as `page.widgets.add` takes it.
- [`SignatureFlags`](forms-and-widgets.md#signatureflags): The signature flags of the AcroForm's `/SigFlags` (ISO 32000-2 Table 225), which signing tools set.
- [`TextField`](forms-and-widgets.md#textfield): A text field, or another widget of the text field of that name, as `page.widgets.add` takes it.
- [`Widget`](forms-and-widgets.md#widget): A handle on one form widget of a page, as `page.widgets` lists it.
- [`Widgets`](forms-and-widgets.md#widgets_1): The form widgets of a page, as `page.widgets` returns them, in `/Annots` order.

## [Outline](outline.md)

- [`Outline`](outline.md#outline_1): The document's outline as its top-level items, as `doc.outline` returns it.
- [`OutlineEntry`](outline.md#outlineentry): One item of an outline to write, as `doc.outline = [...]` takes it.
- [`OutlineItem`](outline.md#outlineitem): A handle on one item of the outline, as `doc.outline` yields it.

## [Threads](threads.md)

- [`Bead`](threads.md#bead): A handle on one bead dictionary of an article thread (ISO 32000-2 Table 163).
- [`Beads`](threads.md#beads): The ordered sequence of `Bead` handles in a `Thread`, as `thread.beads` returns it.
- [`BeadSpecification`](threads.md#beadspecification): One bead to create inside an article thread: a page and a display-space rectangle.
- [`Thread`](threads.md#thread_1): A handle on an indirect article `Thread` dictionary in `Document.threads` (ISO 32000-2 Table 162).
- [`ThreadAction`](threads.md#threadaction): An action that begins reading an article thread (`/S /Thread`, ISO 32000-2 Table 209).
- [`Threads`](threads.md#threads_1): The document's article threads in `Catalog["Threads"]` order, as `doc.threads` returns it.

## [Structure](structure.md)

- [`MarkedContentReference`](structure.md#markedcontentreference): A marked-content item of a structure element (`/K` integer or `/Type /MCR` dictionary).
- [`MATHML_NAMESPACE`](structure.md#mathml_namespace): Standard structure namespace URI for MathML 3.0 elements (ISO 32000-2 §14.8.6.3).
- [`NamespaceRoleMap`](structure.md#namespacerolemap): Live `MutableMapping` over a `StructureNamespace`'s `/RoleMapNS` dictionary (Table 356).
- [`ObjectReference`](structure.md#objectreference): An indirect PDF object item of a structure element (`/Type /OBJR` dictionary).
- [`PDF_1_7_NAMESPACE`](structure.md#pdf_1_7_namespace): Standard structure namespace URI for PDF 1.7 tags (ISO 32000-2 §14.8.6.1, ISO/TS 32005).
- [`PDF_2_0_NAMESPACE`](structure.md#pdf_2_0_namespace): Standard structure namespace URI for PDF 2.0 tags (ISO 32000-2 §14.8.6.2, ISO/TS 32005).
- [`RoleMap`](structure.md#rolemap): The structure tree's `/RoleMap` dictionary as a live mutable mapping.
- [`StructureChildren`](structure.md#structurechildren): The child `StructureElement` handles of one `StructureElement` in `/K` order.
- [`StructureChildRule`](structure.md#structurechildrule): An Annex L relationship, its observed count and the applicable occurrence rule.
- [`StructureElement`](structure.md#structureelement): A handle on an indirect `StructElem` dictionary in `Document.structure`.
- [`StructureNamespace`](structure.md#structurenamespace): Live handle on an indirect `/Type /Namespace` dictionary (ISO 32000-2 §14.7.4, PDF 2.0).
- [`StructureNamespaces`](structure.md#structurenamespaces): Live sequence of `StructureNamespace` handles in `StructTreeRoot['Namespaces']` (PDF 2.0).
- [`StructureText`](structure.md#structuretext): One piece of logical text and its originating element or content reference.
- [`StructureTree`](structure.md#structuretree): The document's logical structure tree as its top-level elements, as `doc.structure` returns it.

## [Attachments](attachments.md)

- [`Attachment`](attachments.md#attachment): A handle on one embedded file of a document, as `doc.attachments[name]` returns it.
- [`Attachments`](attachments.md#attachments_1): The embedded files of a document, keyed by name, as `doc.attachments` returns them.
- [`RelatedFile`](attachments.md#relatedfile): A related filename and its indirect embedded-file stream (ISO 32000-2, 7.11.4.2).

## [Collections](collections.md)

- [`Collection`](collections.md#collection): A portable collection dictionary on `Document.collection` (`Collection`, ISO 32000-2 Table 153).
- [`CollectionColors`](collections.md#collectioncolors): RGB interface colors of a portable collection (`CollectionColors`, ISO 32000-2 Table 157, PDF 2.0).
- [`CollectionField`](collections.md#collectionfield): One schema column of a portable collection (`CollectionField`, ISO 32000-2 Table 155).
- [`CollectionFieldKind`](collections.md#collectionfieldkind): Data type or file-property binding of a `CollectionField` (`/Subtype`, ISO 32000-2 Table 155).
- [`CollectionFolder`](collections.md#collectionfolder): A folder node in a portable collection hierarchy (`CollectionFolder`, ISO 32000-2 Table 159, PDF 2.0).
- [`CollectionSortKey`](collections.md#collectionsortkey): One sort column of a portable collection (`CollectionSort`, ISO 32000-2 Table 156).
- [`CollectionSplit`](collections.md#collectionsplit): Window split configuration of a portable collection (`CollectionSplit`, ISO 32000-2 Table 158, PDF 2.0).
- [`CollectionSplitDirection`](collections.md#collectionsplitdirection): How a viewer splits its window between the collection navigator and document preview (Table 158).
- [`CollectionSubitem`](collections.md#collectionsubitem): A collection item value paired with a display prefix (`CollectionSubitem`, ISO 32000-2 Table 47).
- [`CollectionView`](collections.md#collectionview): Initial view of a portable collection (`/View`, ISO 32000-2 Table 153).
- [`NamedPages`](collections.md#namedpages): The document's `/Names /Pages` name tree as a live mutable mapping (ISO 32000-2 Table 32).
- [`Navigator`](collections.md#navigator): Navigator presentation of a portable collection (`Navigator`, ISO 32000-2 Table 160, PDF 2.0).
- [`WebCapture`](collections.md#webcapture): The stored Web Capture database. Index lookups return writable Arlington content-set views.

## [Measurement and requirements](measurement-and-requirements.md)

- [`CoordinateSystem`](measurement-and-requirements.md#coordinatesystem): A geographic (`/GEOGCS`) or projected (`/PROJCS`) coordinate reference system (Tables 270–271).
- [`DocumentRequirement`](measurement-and-requirements.md#documentrequirement): One viewer capability requirement in `Catalog['Requirements']` (ISO 32000-2 Table 273).
- [`GeospatialMeasure`](measurement-and-requirements.md#geospatialmeasure): A geospatial measure dictionary with full-precision decimal coordinates (`/Subtype /GEO`, Table 269, PDF 2.0).
- [`NumberFormat`](measurement-and-requirements.md#numberformat): One unit and conversion factor in a rectilinear measurement chain (`NumberFormat`, ISO 32000-2 Table 268).
- [`NumberFormatFraction`](measurement-and-requirements.md#numberformatfraction): Fractional display mode of the final `NumberFormat` in a rectilinear unit chain (`/F`, Table 268).
- [`PointData`](measurement-and-requirements.md#pointdata): Extended geospatial point cloud attributes attached to a viewport (`/Type /PtData`, Table 272, PDF 2.0).
- [`RectilinearMeasure`](measurement-and-requirements.md#rectilinearmeasure): A rectilinear coordinate system and unit conversion dictionary (`/Subtype /RL`, ISO 32000-2 Table 267).
- [`RequirementHandler`](measurement-and-requirements.md#requirementhandler): Fallback handler invoked when a viewer cannot satisfy a `DocumentRequirement` (Table 276).
- [`RequirementType`](measurement-and-requirements.md#requirementtype): Standard viewer capability requirement names for `Document.requirements` (ISO 32000-2 Table 275).
- [`Viewport`](measurement-and-requirements.md#viewport): A rectangular measurement region on a page (`/Type /Viewport`, ISO 32000-2 Table 265).

## [Interchange](interchange.md)

- [`AssociatedFile`](interchange.md#associatedfile): Live handle on an `AFFileSpecification` dictionary (ISO 32000-2 §14.13).
- [`AssociatedFileRelationship`](interchange.md#associatedfilerelationship): Semantic relationship of an associated file to its host object (`/AFRelationship`, Table 44).
- [`AssociatedFiles`](interchange.md#associatedfiles): Live sequence of `AssociatedFile` handles in a host's `/AF` array (ISO 32000-2 §14.13).
- [`DeveloperExtension`](interchange.md#developerextension): A developer or ISO extension entry in `Catalog['Extensions']` (ISO 32000-2 §7.12).
- [`DocumentPart`](interchange.md#documentpart): Live handle on an indirect `DPart` node in `Document.parts` (ISO 32000-2 §14.12).
- [`DocumentPartAction`](interchange.md#documentpartaction): An action that jumps to a `DocumentPart` (`/S /GoToDp`, ISO 32000-2 §12.6.4.5, PDF 2.0).
- [`DocumentParts`](interchange.md#documentparts): Live view over `Catalog['DPartRoot']` and its top-level `DocumentPart` nodes (ISO 32000-2 §14.12).
- [`Extensions`](interchange.md#extensions): Live container for `Catalog['Extensions']` keyed by developer prefix (ISO 32000-2 §7.12).
- [`ISO_EXTENSIONS`](interchange.md#iso_extensions): Canonical `(url, extension_revision)` metadata for registered ISO/TS extensions (ISO 32000-2 §7.12).
- [`PieceData`](interchange.md#piecedata): One application's entry in a `/PieceInfo` page-piece dictionary (ISO 32000-2 Table 351).
- [`PieceInfo`](interchange.md#pieceinfo): Live `MutableMapping` over `Catalog['PieceInfo']` or `PageObject['PieceInfo']` (ISO 32000-2 §14.5).

## [History and changes](history-and-changes.md)

- [`ChangeReport`](history-and-changes.md#changereport): What the edits since opening invalidate, for a save that is incremental or not.
- [`ClaimChange`](history-and-changes.md#claimchange): A PDF/A or PDF/UA claim of the metadata that the edits break.
- [`History`](history-and-changes.md#history): The line of steps that undo and redo walk.
- [`Revision`](history-and-changes.md#revision): One incremental file revision of an opened PDF document.
- [`SignatureChange`](history-and-changes.md#signaturechange): An opened signature affected by the save mode or edits to covered objects.
- [`SignaturePermission`](history-and-changes.md#signaturepermission): A signed DocMDP or FieldMDP transform's verdict for one proposed edit.
- [`Transaction`](history-and-changes.md#transaction): A group of edits that commits as one version and one undo step.

## [Encryption](encryption.md)

- [`Access`](encryption.md#access): What a password opened: the user's restricted access, or the owner's full access.
- [`Encryption`](encryption.md#encryption_1): How `Document.save` and `Document.to_bytes` encrypt a full save.
- [`IntegrityReport`](encryption.md#integrityreport): Result of verifying the ISO/TS 32004:2024 MAC of an opened PDF revision.
- [`Permissions`](encryption.md#permissions): What an encrypted document permits the user password, combined with `|`.
- [`RecipientCredential`](encryption.md#recipientcredential): An X.509 recipient certificate and its matching RSA or ECDH private key.
- [`RecipientEncryption`](encryption.md#recipientencryption): Encrypt a full save for certificate recipients with Adobe.PubSec, adbe.pkcs7.s5 and AES.

## [Signing](signing.md)

- [`DocMdpPermission`](signing.md#docmdppermission): Changes permitted after a DocMDP certification signature (`/P`, ISO 32000-2 Table 257).
- [`EncryptedPayload`](signing.md#encryptedpayload): An encrypted PDF payload carried by a PDF 2.0 unencrypted wrapper document (ISO 32000-2 §7.6.7).
- [`FieldLock`](signing.md#fieldlock): Form-field locking specification for `Field.lock` (`SigFieldLock`) and `FieldMDP` transforms.
- [`FieldMdpAction`](signing.md#fieldmdpaction): Which form fields a `FieldLock` locks after signing (`/Action`, ISO 32000-2 Table 236).
- [`LegalAttestation`](signing.md#legalattestation): Legal content attestation dictionary on `Catalog['Legal']` (ISO 32000-2 Table 264, PDF 1.5).
- [`SecurityStore`](signing.md#securitystore): The Document Security Store `Catalog['DSS']` for long-term signature validation (ISO 32000-2 Table 261).
- [`Signature`](signing.md#signature): A signature of the opened file: its field, its signature dictionary, and the revision that it signs.
- [`SignatureVerification`](signing.md#signatureverification): What `Signature.verify` found.
- [`Signer`](signing.md#signer): A signing key or callback, with its certificate chain, which `Document.sign` signs with.
- [`Timestamper`](signing.md#timestamper): A time-stamp callback: it receives the digest of the signature value and the name of the selected SHA-2, SHA-3 or SHAKE256 algorithm and returns the DER of an RFC 3161 time-stamp token over that digest.
- [`ValidationInfo`](signing.md#validationinfo): Validation-related information for one signature in `/DSS /VRI` (ISO 32000-2 Table 262).
- [`vri_key`](signing.md#vri_key): Return the 40-character uppercase SHA-1 hexadecimal `/VRI` key for `signature_contents`.
- [`wrap_encrypted_payload`](signing.md#wrap_encrypted_payload): Create a PDF 2.0 unencrypted wrapper document carrying `payload` (ISO 32000-2 §7.6.7).

## [Limits and errors](limits-and-errors.md)

- [`CancellationToken`](limits-and-errors.md#cancellationtoken): A flag that stops the operations of every document whose limits carry it.
- [`DocumentClosedError`](limits-and-errors.md#documentclosederror): An operation on a closed document.
- [`DocumentLimits`](limits-and-errors.md#documentlimits): Optional budgets for opening and reading PDFs.
- [`EncryptedDocumentError`](limits-and-errors.md#encrypteddocumenterror): An operation on an encrypted document that needs a password.
- [`InternalError`](limits-and-errors.md#internalerror): A Rust panic in pyropdf or an engine. The message retains the panic; please report this library defect.
- [`LIMIT_CODES`](limits-and-errors.md#limit_codes): Each code and when an operation reaches it, in the order of the registry.
- [`LimitCode`](limits-and-errors.md#limitcode): A stable code that `LimitError.code` carries.
- [`LimitError`](limits-and-errors.md#limiterror): A refusal by a limit, whose `code` names the limit.
- [`MalformedPdfError`](limits-and-errors.md#malformedpdferror): Input that cannot be read as a PDF document, including empty input.
- [`OcrError`](limits-and-errors.md#ocrerror): OCR model loading or inference failed.
- [`PasswordError`](limits-and-errors.md#passworderror): A password that matches neither the user password nor the owner password.
- [`PdfError`](limits-and-errors.md#pdferror): The base class of the errors that pyropdf raises for a document.
- [`PyropdfWarning`](limits-and-errors.md#pyropdfwarning): A recoverable condition of reading a PDF, such as glyphs that text extraction left out.
- [`StaleObjectError`](limits-and-errors.md#staleobjecterror): Use of a handle whose object the current version no longer has.
- [`StalePageError`](limits-and-errors.md#stalepageerror): Use of a `Page` whose page object the page tree no longer lists.

## [Content operations](content-operations.md)

- [`InlineImage`](content-operations.md#inlineimage): An inline image: its dictionary, keyed by name text as written, and its data.
- [`Operation`](content-operations.md#operation): One content-stream operation: an operator and its operands.
- [`Operations`](content-operations.md#operations): An immutable sequence of content-stream operations.

## [Objects](objects.md)

- [`Array`](objects.md#array): A PDF array; elements resolve and write as `Dictionary` values do.
- [`Dictionary`](objects.md#dictionary): A PDF dictionary keyed by name text without the slash.
- [`Name`](objects.md#name): A PDF name, such as `/Type`, held without its leading slash.
- [`Objects`](objects.md#objects_1): The indirect objects of a document, keyed by object number.
- [`Real`](objects.md#real): A PDF real: a `float` that keeps the digits it is written with.
- [`Stream`](objects.md#stream): A PDF stream: its dictionary, plus `read` and `write`.
- [`String`](objects.md#string): A PDF string: its bytes, with `text` decoding a text string.

## [Geometry](geometry.md)

- [`IRect`](geometry.md#irect): An immutable integer rectangle `(x0, y0, x1, y1)`.
- [`Matrix`](geometry.md#matrix): An immutable affine matrix `(a, b, c, d, e, f)`.
- [`Point`](geometry.md#point): An immutable point `(x, y)` in display coordinates.
- [`Quad`](geometry.md#quad_1): An immutable quadrilateral of four corner points `(ul, ur, ll, lr)`.
- [`Rect`](geometry.md#rect_2): An immutable rectangle `(x0, y0, x1, y1)` in display coordinates.

## [Checks and profiles](checks-and-profiles.md)

- [`DefectKind`](checks-and-profiles.md#defectkind): The category of a `StructuralDefect`.
- [`OutputIntent`](checks-and-profiles.md#outputintent): One entry of the catalog's `/OutputIntents`.
- [`Profiles`](checks-and-profiles.md#profiles): The profile claims of a document's XMP metadata, and its output intents.
- [`StructuralDefect`](checks-and-profiles.md#structuraldefect): One departure of the document from the model.
- [`StructuralReport`](checks-and-profiles.md#structuralreport): What the structural check found.

## [Typed objects](typed-objects.md)

- [`typed`](typed-objects.md#pyropdftyped): Typed views of PDF objects, one per object type of the Arlington PDF Model.
- [`typed.ArrayView`](typed-objects.md#typedarrayview): The base of the views of array types.
- [`typed.DictionaryView`](typed-objects.md#typeddictionaryview): The base of the views of dictionary types.
- [`typed.LinkedTree`](typed-objects.md#typedlinkedtree): A name or number tree with the Arlington types declared for its leaf values.
- [`typed.StreamView`](typed-objects.md#typedstreamview): The base of the views of stream types.
- [`typed.TYPES`](typed-objects.md#typedtypes): The object types of the model, sorted.
- [`typed.View`](typed-objects.md#typedview): A typed view of one object: the base of the views of every object type.
